title: British Airways' Scary Descent, American Kills "Invols," and the Flydubai Plot Gets Darker
summary: A British Airways 777 loses pressurization over the Irish Sea and drops 27,000 feet in under ten minutes — we break down why the real drama happened after the masks came down. Plus, American Airlines says no more bumping passengers off oversold flights, new details emerge on just how long the flydubai attacker was planning his attack, and American can't decide if it's adding routes or cutting them.
